lines.label: Supportable debt
lines.note: the largest loan the net operating income carries: the lender wants net income 1.10 times the loan payment (the debt coverage ratio), at 6.19% repaid over 40 years (the amortization), $1,498,247 a year in payments

lines.label: Funding
